matches.title: New TDS Feature Idea
matches.snippet: New TDS Feature Idea Daily Challenges Gives coins, tickets and consumable upon beating. It is a mode from molten to frost that has a catch. These catches are randomized and changed daily. Examples: No Special Towers (No golden, hardcore, evolved or exclusive) on Fallen mode Frost waves 30-40 with only Spawner towers (35,000 starting cash) (unowned spawner towers can also be used for testing. Exclusive towers don’t count). Molten with only golden demoman and ranger Etc Weekly Challenges Gives a lot of coins, gems. matches.title: Is TDS an analogy for the 2008 housing and economic crisis?
matches.snippet: Is TDS an analogy for the 2008 housing and economic crisis? The 2008 housing and economic crisis was a time period where the housing market bubble popped and caused a recession. Tds is a roblox game. Now on paper these 2 do not have anything in common. However, there are plenty of similarities. Lets start at the beginning: in the 90s the US goverment passed and changed some laws making low income houses more affordable with lower interest rates and such. This allowed for people to make more riskier investments. In 2021 there were only about 8 or so vaible towers in tds. You had accel and gmini for dps.
